name: kontrakan-voting
description: Voting dua video kontrakan. Halaman statis, backend SQLite yang bisa ditukar.

scripts.migrasi: wrangler d1 migrations apply kontrakan-voting --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrasi:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply kontrakan-voting --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.cadangan: wrangler d1 export kontrakan-voting --remote --output cadangan/suara.sql --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: node alat/rapikan-deskripsi.mjs --uji && node test-api.mjs && node test-api.mjs --worker && node test-ui.mjs && node test-ui.mjs --relatif && node test-ui.mjs --tanpa-api
